hotels.title: New South Wales Coastal Escape Steps from Yamba Main Beach with Daily Surfboard Hire
hotels.description: Explore the sheer charm of one of coastal New South Wales' most tranquil towns with a relaxing stay at The Cove Yamba. Whether you're swimming, surfing or fishing, this big blue backyard offers something to entertain all guests. With the crashing waves of Yamba Main Beach just a short stroll from your front door, come to and from the vibrant beach area within minutes to relax in your very own oasis. Experience laid-back living in a spacious self-contained apartment, each designed with a private balcony overlooking the ocean or the property's gardens. Unwind in the outdoor swimming pool or heated spa after days spent surfing down at the beach, try your hand at a friendly hit of tennis at The Beachside Leisure Centre, or take advantage of your dining and drinks discounts at the Yamba Golf & Country Club. From the sandy shores to the inviting town just minutes away, you'll feel calm and rested at this pristine destination.

hotels.title: NSW North Coast Beachfront One-, Two- & Three-Bedroom Apartments near Pippi Beach
hotels.description: Gather your friends and family at this self-contained beachfront escape, just moments from stunning Pippi Beach. Spend warm days lounging by one of two serene swimming pools, lap up the coastal lifestyle, try some tennis, or stroll just 50 metres to the beachfront for surf, sand and sea. After a day of relaxation or exploration, return to the comfort of your pristine apartment or villa. Only 90 minutes from Byron Bay, Yamba is your gateway to myriad outdoor pursuits with plentiful beaches and nature trails. For an easier day out, enjoy food and beverage discounts at the local Yamba Golf & Country Club - a championship course with spectacular food and stunning restaurant views over the fairways.
